audit.why: EVEN 6/10 fits 52.02% over 792 games. Pantheon owns levels 1-3, the lane slips from 4 on, and Akshan's camouflage roams plus crit scaling take over the side lane. Difficulty is decided by terrain: Heroic Swing needs a wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows never name a single Akshan ability and give no cooldowns; the first-item row also contradicts the level chart (see notes).
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5 at 850 range, Going Rogue 18/14/10/6/2, Comeuppance 100/85/70. Those numbers are what make 'his tempo window is closing' mean anything.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name Heroic Swing, Avengerang, Going Rogue, Comeuppance and Dirty Fighting with their real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. Heroic Swing requires terrain to grapple into, and Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits.
audit.why: Riot's Heroic Swing text: 'fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it'. Riot's Comeuppance text: the volley damages 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit'. So open lane disarms his escape, and a minion body eats his ultimate.
audit.corrected: Fight him in open lane where Heroic Swing has no wall; keep a minion between you and a channelling Comeuppance.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dirty Fighting is never mentioned, yet it shields him every third hit against a champion.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags it, and Riot's text confirms: every three hits deals bonus damage 'and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion'. That shield eats the tail of your burst.
audit.corrected: Dirty Fighting's shield now appears in the first-item spike and the early-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Coverage flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and the cooldown block carried no numbers.
audit.why: The lane is played on Heroic Swing's 18s and Shield Vault's 13s.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block and the do/report entries now carry 18s, 9s, 100s, 13s and 180s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded that Going Rogue's camouflage decays fast in the open.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.' That tells you where to ward and where he cannot vanish.
audit.corrected: Recorded in the audit; no writable string had room for it without breaking the length band.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your only edge here, so take them. At Level 1 your point-and-click W stun plus a held, max-range Q is real burst Akshan cannot answer until his E swing comes up — punish him on a Q last-hit while he's grounded. Use E to block his Q poke and his W bolt rather than eating it. Do NOT W in onto an Akshan who still has his grapple charged near terrain, or he just swings out and you've spent your gap-closer for nothing.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your only edge here, so take them. At Level 1 your point-and-click Shield Vault plus a held, max-range Comet Spear is real burst Akshan cannot answer until Heroic Swing comes up — punish him on a last-hit out in open lane. Turn into Avengerang so Aegis Assault eats it from the front. Do NOT W onto an Akshan standing next to terrain with his grapple up, or he swings out and you have spent your gap-closer for nothing.

edits.before: From 4-6 the lane slips. He stabilizes with double-bounce Q poke from outside your held-Q range, and his E swing means your W-stun all-in only lands if you catch him away from walls. At 6 he gets camouflage and Grand Starfall is more roam than 1v1 — so the play is to leave: R to a side lane and cash your early tempo into a kill elsewhere before he does the same to you with his own roam pressure.
edits.after: From 4-6 the lane slips. Avengerang pokes from 850, outside Comet Spear's 575, and Heroic Swing means your Shield Vault all-in only lands away from walls. At 6 he adds Going Rogue camouflage and Comeuppance, which stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits — keep a minion between you while he stores it. Grand Starfall is a roam, not a duel: leave and cash your tempo elsewhere.

edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it needs terrain — engage in open lane, or when it's down. - Avengerang: 9s poke. - Comeuppance: 100s, minion-blockable. - Shield Vault: 13s, never on chip. - Grand Starfall: 180s only.
